error: [quantize] The requested number of bits 1 is not supported. The supported bits are 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8.
analysis: Stock MLX cannot represent 1-bit affine quantized layers. MLXLMCommon/Load.swift:41 reads the config.json quantization block and calls quantize(model:) to convert each Linear that has loaded scales into a QuantizedLinear; that conversion runs affine_quantize, which rejects bits < 2 before the real 1-bit weights are ever applied. dequantize accepts bits >= 1, but it is not on this path, so reading only dequantize gives a false positive for support.
upstreamCheck: ml-explore/mlx main enforces the same 2..8 bit whitelist as of 2026-09-10, and mlx-swift's newest release is 0.31.6, so no available version bump changes this. Prism ML's card advertises 'custom 1-bit hybrid-attention kernels on Apple MLX (Python, Swift)', which is consistent with the 1-bit path living in their own kernels rather than upstream MLX.
